-- TTEX Talk Scene File: DO NOT EDIT BY HAND
-- Quest #1000 / Scene #9 - Function tutorial5_1
function tutorial5_1()
	SetTransitionType(2)
	SetFinalMusic("")
	HideOriginalObjs(1)
	Phase1()

	LoadMap("town000D.map")
	MoveCamera(437.00, 392.00, 83.34)
	RotCamera(4.77, 1.43, 30.00)

	CreateObject(0, 10014, 432.00, 391.00, 192, 0, FALSE, 0, 0)

	Phase2()
	Phase3()
	Phase4()

	wait(500)
	OpenTalkScene(3, 9)

	RevPhase4()
	RevPhase3()
	RevPhase2()

	Q.DeleteAllObject()
	RestoreMap()

	RevPhase1()
end

Register(tutorial5_1)
